text:
anna: Quick sync — we need to define the runtime_insights dashboard inputs so oncall + billing teams have useful metrics. Key inputs I need from eng-runtime / eng-platform: router decisions (routed_policy), latency breakdown (queue, compute, stream), cache hit rates, model-variant counts, and per-request token counts. Also need exporter contract and retention/backfill plan.

kevin: For exporter contract let's push proto v2 that is small and typed. Minimal fields: timestamp, metric, value, model_id, routing_policy, sample_rate, shard_id. Example payload: 
```
{ "ts": "2026-03-18T14:22:00Z", "metric": "router_routed", "model": "gptx-1", "policy": "latency_prefer", "value": 1 }
```
kevin: Also we should add `sample_rate` to support high-frequency router events; default 0.01 for router hits.

sara: +1. We also need `kv_cache_hit_rate` and `prefix_cache_lookups` from runtime. Those are lightweight counters we can export every 10s.

tomas: For retention: dashboards should keep raw high-cardinality router samples 7d, aggregated rollups 90d, billing aggregates 365d. Backfill: do we want to backfill 90d? cost estimate ~1200 GPU hours if we rerun full export across logs.

anna: Can we do a cheaper backfill: run aggregations only (no raw re-ingest) for 90d using sampling + sketching? If sketching acceptable we can keep error <1%.

kevin: I can add a `sketch` flag in exporter metadata to emit t-digest summaries instead of raw events (tdigest + counts). That should massively reduce compute for backfill.

sara: runtime can toggle sketch mode per pool, default off. Need config rollout plan — don't enable globally until we validate sketches on staging.

deploy-bot: exporter-schema-v2 deployed to staging at 1902345682 by kevin.

anna: Action items: kevin create proto PR + schema doc (owner: kevin) by EOD. sara to add kv cache metrics + sketch toggle to staging by tomorrow. tomas to produce cost estimate + retention config for infra billing by Thu. I'll draft dashboard wireframes and UX notes and share in #dashboards. :thumbsup:

kevin: noted, will PR today.

sara: ack, starting the runtime patch now.

tomas: I'll run a small 7d backfill smoke to validate numbers before we commit to a big run.

anna: Good plan — let's reconvene after the PR lands and the staging exporters emit sketches. If someone wants the rough backfill compute model I posted earlier I can paste it here.
